command:
set -u
C=$PWD; O=$ROBOROBO_OUT; B=${O%/sequel/*}/git/sequel.git; N=16f33345b89927ddbe1c1a737a2dd1b32dffc189
echo "bare=$B" > $O/setup.txt
E=$O/nudge-engine
git clone -q --shared --no-checkout $B $E && git -C $E checkout -q --detach $N || { echo "checkout failed" >> $O/setup.txt; exit 3; }
git -C $E rev-parse HEAD > $O/engine_commit.txt
git -C $C rev-parse HEAD > $O/main_commit.txt
git -C $E log --format="%H %ad %s" -8 > $O/engine_log.txt
git -C $E branch method-nudge $N && git -C $E bundle create $O/method-nudge.bundle method-nudge 2>> $O/setup.txt
mkdir -p $O/w && cd $O/w
for which in nudge main; do
  if [ $which = nudge ]; then P=$E; else P=$C; fi
  NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=$O/w/nb-$which PYTHONPATH=$P uv run --project $C python -c "import granular,sys,pytest; print(\"imported_from\", granular.__file__); sys.exit(pytest.main([\"-q\",\"-p\",\"no:cacheprovider\",sys.argv[1]]))" $C/referee/tests > $O/frozen-$which.txt 2>&1
  echo "$which rc=$?" >> $O/rc.txt
done
cd $O && rm -rf $O/w $E
cat $O/rc.txt
